attribution: Obere Gutachterausschuss NRW / Land Nordrhein-Westfalen (BORIS.NRW), Immobilienrichtwerte NRW, open geodata (Datenlizenz Deutschland - Zero - Version 2.0). Matched-zone yearly chain of the standard values of condominiums, built by us.
basis: Median change of the committee's Immobilienrichtwert (EUR/m2, resale condominiums) over the zones published in both of two consecutive years, chained, annual (1 January)
name: Hagen
notes: Hagen: yearly chain of the Gutachterausschuss's Immobilienrichtwerte (official standard values, EUR/m2) for resale condominiums, 1 January of each year, 2018 to 2026; each step is the median change of the zones valued in both years (38 to 38 zones). Annual points; the quarters between are interpolated by the builder. Standard values are set from the previous year's purchase prices, so a value dated 1 January lags transaction prices by about a year (against GREIX in Dortmund and Düsseldorf). A committee that re-draws its zones or re-calibrates its reference dwelling moves the median in that year. Houses and terraced houses are segments where long enough; 3 districts (Stadtteile / Stadtbezirke) with at least 3 zones in every step are shown.
